title: Standing on FURM ground - A framework for evaluating Fair, Useful, and Reliable AI Models in healthcare systems
reasoning: The paper introduces the FURM framework, where the 'F' stands for Fair and includes a dedicated 'Ethical considerations' component (Stage 1d) as one of its four foundational evaluation pillars. This component evaluates AI models against seven core ethical principles (responsibility, equity, traceability, reliability, governance, nonmaleficence, and autonomy) and is a primary structural element of the proposed methodology rather than a brief closing section.
